LOCAL GOVERNMENT ROUNDUP

Boards across the Wausau area packed their agendas this week with budget previews, subdivision reviews, and school-calendar decisions, though most outcomes remain pending from agenda-only meetings.

  • The Wausau School Board was set to vote on the 2026-27 tax levies for the general, community service, and debt service funds at its annual budget hearing Monday.
  • The School Board was also set to consider an early-start resolution for the 2027-28 school year and approve a batch of personnel actions at a special meeting.
  • Kronenwetter's Village Board was set to review the 2027 budget preview alongside a 10-year capital improvements program and consider the Green Tree Trails Subdivision preliminary plat.
  • The School Board's Committee of the Whole was set to vote on the 2027-28 school calendar and update Policy 2370 to recognize the Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy.
  • Kronenwetter's Police and Fire Commission was set to interview a Fire Department applicant in closed session and take any resulting action Monday evening.
  • The Wausau School Board convened in closed session twice on September 21 to conduct pupil expulsion hearings under Wisconsin Statutes; outcomes were not publicly disclosed.

Coming up: Monday is the busiest day of the week ahead, with the City of Wausau's Public Health & Safety Committee meeting at 5:30 PM and the Village of Weston's Comprehensive Plan Steering Committee also convening that evening. The City of Wausau's Board of Public Works meets Tuesday morning at 10:30 AM, followed by the Weston Village Board of Trustees that evening.
